| `code-exemplars-blueprint-generator` | Recriar exemplars.md |
| `copilot-instructions-blueprint-generator` | Recriar copilot instructions |
| `folder-structure-blueprint-generator` | Recriar estrutura de pastas |

Skills ativas: ver [`.github/README.md`](../../README.md).
